summary.en: On a Sunday morning, without a clear start of why, Yusuke Sakon has been calling his girlfriend Aki Kano while running to her apartment. Her apartment was closed, so he asks the building manager Hayashi for a spare key to her room. When they open the room, however, she is found dead inside. The police find a cup of coffee containing cyanide, suggesting the cause of death. They also find an investigation report made by Kogoro, so he is summoned to the scene.
